title: Renowned marine scientist warns of industrial fishing's toll on PH waters

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A globally recognized marine scientist has called for reduced fishing activity in Philippine waters, particularly in coastal areas increasingly encroached upon by large commercial vessels, saying rebuilding overexploited fish populations requires fishing less. “The only measure which ensures the rebuilding of overexploited fish stocks is to fish less. This applies especially to coastal areas, which are increasingly invaded by huge industrial vessels (worldwide, including in the Philippines). There is no alternative to this,” said Dr. Daniel Pauly, a marine conservation expert and board member of global ocean conservation group Oceana. Pauly made the recommendation during a public lecture […]... Keep on reading: Renowned marine scientist warns of industrial fishing's toll on PH waters
